mapper.update: UPDATE prd_document p SET draft_json = v.editor_json, draft_markdown = v.markdown_snapshot, revision = p.revision + 1, patch_checkpoint_revision = p.revision + 1, current_version_id = v.id, updated_at = now() FROM prd_version v WHERE p.id = #{prdId} AND v.id = #{versionId} AND v.prd_id = p.id AND p.revision = #{revision}
UPDATE prd_patch SET status = 'STALE' WHERE prd_id = #{prdId} AND status = 'PENDING'
